## kb_to_source

Every normative sentence of the 13 documents above traces to an atom of the source (rule, overwrite, factor ladder, base clause, variant parameter, tool contract). Worked figures and boundary pairs are labelled hypothetical and are derivations of the stated rules (checked: 13.0187→13.02 style rounding, 31.70×0.6=19.02, reissue calendar 20 May/29 Jul/7 Oct/16 Dec 2032, 31/30-day promotion boundary). No added confirmation, review, notification or procedure.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none (no "if unmet, first call …"; the installation hub names only its own tool; the renewal hub names only its own tool).
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none (grep of task values 227.37, 67.47, 222.37, 74.97, northbank, certificate id: no hit in docs/).

Notes (not defects):
- N1: support_desk_renewals 1.3 renders "by 1 to max_subscription_years years" as "by one year up to the longest subscription the product allows"; read as the range one to three years it is equivalent; the branch (dashboard renewals) is untriggered here.
- Computation documents carry the source's assembly sentences ("Any fixed fee is added, and any fixed credit subtracted, only after the rounded amount is taken"; "Every fixed credit the managed installation carries is subtracted …"). These are rule sentences of the source, not hints of an exception list; recorded for consistency only.

## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION PASS** (task 0). No omission, softening, addition or retired-surface error found across the full domain of both policies, all nine factor ladders and the base clauses read.

## dependency_form

- Prerequisite sentence: verbatim on the blocked side only (managed_installation_service §3.1; §3.2 same-form restatement in the same doc). Not RED.
- Tool names: each task tool appears only in its own hub (renew_… in support_desk_renewals; pay_… in managed_installation_service).
- No document strings renewal and installation into a route, step list, table or FAQ; no wrong-vs-right contrast; the renewal documents never mention the installation and vice versa (the re-installation-fee and same-day-renewal factor documents state their own tiers only).
- Titles general ("Managed Certificate Installation Service", "Certificate Renewals Booked by Harborline Support", "Same-Day Renewal Credit on Certificate Installation", …); none mirrors "installing on a second server".
- Factor documents do not say which tier customers usually fall on; computation documents carry no "unless otherwise provided"/exception list/pointer.
- Depended-on document findable through the records' and the sentence's own words ("renewal", "renewed", "subscription end date").

**KB-EXPLICIT PASS** (task 0).
